title: Prove failed member recovery delivery and manual resume
text: The authoritative recipe and reachable CLI help are source evidence. Existing focused tests cover routing and dependency/candidate contracts; they do not prove a real parked owner received the notice, resumed on a surface without automatic wake, checked all blockers and ran QA on the corrected deployed candidate. Record the next authorized real occurrence as evidence; do not manufacture a production failure or host reset to verify prose.
